- Compute intersection endpoints: left = max(a1, a2), right = min(b1, b2). If left > right, no overlap -> return "NO". Length for closed intervals is L = right - left (number of unit gaps). If L < 2, not prime -> "NO".
- Implement is_prime for non-negative integers: handle small cases (0,1 non-prime; 2 prime; even >2 non-prime); trial divide odd factors up to sqrt(n).
- If is_prime(L) -> return "YES", else "NO".
